<section class="ruled-section history-section">
  <p class="section-index">Selected history</p>
  <div class="timeline">
    <article>
      <time datetime="2016">2016</time>
      <div><h2>The working group is founded</h2><p>The group was constituted at the 36th SEIO Congress in Toledo, with the aim of providing a meeting point and shared reference for Bayesian statisticians in Spain.</p></div>
    </article>
    <article>
      <time datetime="2023">2023</time>
      <div><h2>Three sessions at the XL SEIO Congress</h2><p>At the SEIO Congress in Elche, the group organised sessions on variable selection, early-career research and work by national and international researchers, including an invited contribution by Maria Kalli.</p></div>
    </article>
    <article>
      <time datetime="2024-06-17">2024</time>
      <div>
        <h2>I International Workshop on Bayesian Statistics</h2>
        <p>The first workshop was held on 17–18 June at Universidad Carlos III de Madrid’s Puerta de Toledo campus. It brought together 37 participants for 17 talks.</p>
        <details>
          <summary>Speakers and scientific committee</summary>
          <div class="archive-details">
            <p><strong>Keynote speakers:</strong> Alan Gelfand (Duke University), Simon Wilson (Trinity College Dublin) and Miguel Ángel Gómez Villegas (Universidad Complutense de Madrid / Universidad CEU San Pablo).</p>
            <p><strong>Invited speakers:</strong> María Eugenia Castellanos (Universidad Rey Juan Carlos), David Conesa (Universitat de València), Gonzalo García-Donato (Universidad de Castilla-La Mancha), Rosario Susi (Universidad Complutense de Madrid) and Pilar Gargallo (Universidad de Zaragoza).</p>
            <p><strong>Scientific committee:</strong> Conchi Ausín, Stefano Cabras, Juanmi Díaz-Araque, Pepa Ramírez-Cobo and Mike Wiper.</p>
          </div>
        </details>
        <a class="source-link" href="https://seio-bayes.webnode.es/first-international-workshop-on-bayesian-statistics/">Original 2024 event page ↗</a>
      </div>
    </article>
    <article>
      <time datetime="2026-06-04">2026</time>
      <div><h2>II International Workshop on Bayesian Statistics</h2><p>The second edition was hosted by CUNEF Universidad in Madrid. Its full programme, book of abstracts, brochure, venue information and committees remain available in the <a href="conference.html">event archive</a>.</p></div>
    </article>
  </div>
